categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Xinguodu Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three segments: payment services, electronic payment devices, and artificial intelligence. The payment services include domestic and cross-border card acquiring and value-added services. The electronic payment devices segment focuses on the design, development, production, and sales of POS terminals and related hardware. The AI segment involves development and application of general-purpose AI agents and AIGC products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digital payment technologies, including smart POS terminals integrating biometric and cloud capabilities. It employs proprietary AI technologies for intelligent risk control and digital operations. Manufacturing involves high-quality supply chain management and certifications such as MPoC, PCI P2PE, and international security standards. The company also develops SaaS platforms for payment and merchant management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include banks, merchants across retail, hospitality, transportation, logistics, and healthcare sectors, as well as cross-border e-commerce enterprises. The company serves both domestic Chinese markets and international clients, including merchants in Europe, the US, Japan, and emerging markets. It targets small and medium-sized enterprises with digital payment and operational solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations cover over 300 cities in China including Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan, and extend to more than 100 countries globally. Major overseas markets include Europe, North America, Japan, Southeast Asia, Africa, and Latin America. The company has established local teams and holds multiple international payment licenses in Luxembourg, Hong Kong, the US, and others.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the electronic payment supply chain. It manufactures and sells payment terminals (hardware) and provides payment processing and value-added services (software and services). It also acts as a payment acquirer and service provider, linking merchants with banks and clearing institutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening the integration of payment services with digital merchant operations, expanding global payment license coverage, and enhancing AI-driven intelligent risk control and operational efficiency. R&D focuses on high-end smart POS devices, SoftPOS solutions, cloud payment platforms, and AI applications such as digital employees and AIGC content generation. The company invests heavily in technology innovation and ecosystem collaboration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of electronic payment terminals and related hardware, and service sales including card acquiring, payment processing, SaaS merchant management solutions, and AI-powered operational services. The company also earns licensing and value-added service fees, and cross-border payment transaction fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with domestic POS terminal manufacturers like PAX, Landi, and Newland, and third-party payment acquirers such as UnionPay Merchant Services, Lakala, and Yitongxingyi. It holds a strong position in overseas markets due to early international expansion and comprehensive payment license portfolio. The company emphasizes integrated hardware-software solutions and global payment capabilities to differentiate itself.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 3.15 billion, a 17.2% decrease from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 234 million, down 69%. Despite revenue decline, gross margin improved to 40.56%. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 5.69 billion and equity of RMB 4.2 billion. It continues to invest around 8.8% of revenue in R&D to support growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xinguodu emphasizes technology-driven payment solutions combining secure, high-quality hardware with intelligent software services. Its unique value lies in integrated 'payment + operation' ecosystems, AI-enabled risk management, and extensive global payment license coverage. The company offers tailored industry solutions, multi-language support, and cross-border payment capabilities, enhancing merchant efficiency and customer experience while maintaining competitive cost advantages.
